routes.purpose: A broad continuous shore return bypasses every wall chain
A long open approach makes spell travel and braking visible
Approach either wall face; release and redirect across the open gaps
Long straights and open corners support sprint, slide and finite braking
A clear crossing returns to the grove without an advanced move
Choose a short wall contact or weave around the grove
A clear outside lane keeps each cover exercise optional
Open center connects the safe return to both cover approaches
Wall corners offer a committed turn with a visible route around each block
Broad perimeter keeps all viewpoints reachable by ordinary walking
A long exposed crossing rewards reading incoming travel
Short contact walls alternate with exposed landings and open retreats

stations.title: MOVEMENT GUIDE
lines: Jump lifts up; directions steer in the air
Slide again to brake; Evade rolls or air-dodges
Wall / Turn follows contact; away input detaches
Release direction to brake; tap Jump for a short hop
Controls share this Lodge directory
Every ordinary path is open without techniques

stations.title: RESTORE PRACTICE
lines: Restores Health, Flux and Stamina
Clears temporary spells, matter and reactions
Targets also return three seconds after defeat
Use the Crucible for isolated pair experiments

stations.title: IMPACT PRACTICE
lines: Hold a direction to bend the launch
Press V near landing to spend 18 Stamina
No V: read the full 220 ms brace

stations.title: CHAMPION GALLERY
lines: Race columns, hover details, host-confirmed choice
Temporary art is labeled; all movement stays

stations.title: SPELL LOOM
lines: Choose Bolt, Heavy, Rapid or Spray
Water, Fire, Air, Earth, Light, Dark
12 slots on 1-4, Ctrl and Alt
Try all 504 spells in the optional Spell Range
Eight deliveries; each with finite paid effects
Combine matter; Ice and Charge are derived effects

stations.title: HOST FARFLOW
lines: Hosts UDP 24872 for up to eight
Share your address with trusted friends
Choose Close Session here to end hosting

stations.title: JOIN FARFLOW
lines: Type or paste the host address
The last valid address is saved here
Choose Leave Session here to disconnect

stations.title: FARFLOW CHARTER
lines: Choose social, sparring, or duel rules
The host seals the charter when opening Farflow

stations.title: SESSION HEARTH
lines: Gather connected travellers here
Everyone readies; the host begins the round

stations.title: COMPANY LEDGER
lines: Host-only connected traveller selection
Selection alone never dismisses anyone

stations.title: REMOVE TRAVELLER
lines: Uses the traveller named by the Ledger
A second press confirms within three seconds

stations.title: CONTROLS
lines: Keyboard, mouse, wheel and controller
Conflicts swap safely; every change persists
Escape returns to the Lodge directory

movement_courses.purpose: Build speed along the shore, attach to the wall, then release a walljump; the broad shore route stays free.
Carry speed into the grove, brake to a controlled walk, then rejoin the loop; a wall route is optional.
Attach to a foundry wall, leave it with a different travel direction, then land ready to aim; take the open bypass when exposed.
Cross the exposed terrace with a paid slide and jump, then land and let Stamina recover; the outer path offers a slower approach.
